learning_outcomes.text: Defines clutches and brakes, calculates moment transmission / performs strength control.
Defines, classifies, and performs calculations for belt-pulley systems.
Defines, classifies, and performs calculations / strength control for gears.
Knows about friction, wear, and lubrication.
Defines, classifies, calculates, and selects bearings from standards.

syllabus_topics: Classification, design, selection, and analysis of machine elements according to their functions.
Shape / force-dependent motion and power transmission elements: Gears, clutches, belt-pulley mechanisms
Tribology and its components, plain bearings, rolling bearings
Gears: Calculation of spur and helical gear systems
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated with 60% from in-term work and 40% from the final exam. In-term work components are weighted as follows: Midterm Exam 50%, Quiz 1 10%, Quiz 2 10%, Assignment 1 30%.
